text:
elise_cs: Heads-up — Polemontu just flagged three new product teams (Docs, Billing, CX Insights) going live next month and asked for guidance on scaling. They reported a ~3x QPS bump in the last 6 hours. Renewal in 45 days, strong upsell opportunity but also risk if latency degrades.

sam_sre: Oof, 3x overnight is notable. Do we have per-route metrics for the last 24h to confirm whether it's a steady shift or a spike? link: https://console.redwood/integrations/polemontu/usage ?

elise_cs: I pulled a quick snapshot — embeddings + chat generation routes are the heavy hitters. See summary below.

elise_cs: ```
Estimated increase: +210% avg token/s, peak +320%
Top routes: /v1/chat/completions (60%), /v1/embeddings (30%)
Client plan: Team Pro (no reserved capacity)
Renewal window: 45d
```

devon_se: If they keep that profile they'll hit burst throttles and see degraded tail latency. Recommend we propose a Dedicated pilot (small GPU pool + autoscale) or suggest batching/kv-cache changes. I can draft config recs. :+1:

tony_support: From enablement POV, they also asked for best-practice prompts for doc summarization and cost controls. I can run a short workshop next week if we align on quota and expected patterns. Suggestions?

zoe_research: Suggest trying quantized model variant for embeddings (q4f16) — ~35% token cost reduction with minimal quality delta on their dataset. Also early caching on repeated context sequences for billing-heavy workflows.

elise_cs: Action items: 1) devon draft Dedicated pilot proposal + cost delta (owner: devon_se) 2) zoe produce quick eval comparing q4f16 vs baseline on sample docs (owner: zoe_research) 3) tony schedule enablement workshop and collect top 5 prompt examples (owner: tony_support) 4) ops run per-route 24h and 7d dashboards and flag TRs if error rate >1% (owner: sam_sre).

onboardbot: A provisioning request has been created: PR-97421 for Polemontu pilot capacity (ETA: 3 business days).

sam_sre: I'll check error budgets and set an alert for tail latency > 250ms p95 for their org id. If we see sustained tail, we'll auto-failover to a lower-cost variant per rollout policy.

elise_cs: Also capturing customer sentiment: they called this a "growth week" and are excited but anxious about uptime during demos to prospects. Let's prioritize low-friction options (workshop + config tweaks) and follow with Dedicated pilot if they sign.

devon_se: Drafting pilot doc now. ETA EOD. If anyone has sample traffic shape or auth headers, drop in #internal-traffic or DM me.

tony_support: I'll ping Polemontu for preferred time slots (Wed/Thu next week) and gather their top 10 example docs.

zoe_research: I'll run a quick evaluation on 200 docs and share a short table in this thread tomorrow.

elise_cs: Thanks team. I'll update the CSM account page and mark renewal as "high-opportunity" with a risk flag until we see stability. :rocket:

sam_sre: Quick query to reproduce usage shape for anyone who needs it:

curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://api.redwood/v1/usage?org=polemontu&range=24h" | jq '.routes|map({route,requests,avg_latency_ms})'

elise_cs: If we want to schedule a sync with sales for potential committed capacity pricing, suggest Fri 10am PT — anyone object?

devon_se: Works for me.

tony_support: Good for me.

zoe_research: Free then.

elise_cs: Great — I'll book and include a short agenda: status, pilot proposal, pricing options, enablement plan.

onboardbot: Meeting created: Polemontu growth sync — Fri 10:00 PT. Calendar invite sent to participants.
